title: kb/_self/token-efficiency.md states what the multi-agent runs show
goal: kb/_self/token-efficiency.md gains a section Concurrent agents stating the conclusions the multi rows support on concurrency against the sequential baseline, coord dedup, prompt-cache reuse, Haiku against Sonnet and Opus per role, the pack budget and kb tools against reading files; each conclusion cites the section of the benchmarks report it rests on

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail

import re
t = open("kb/_self/token-efficiency.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
m = re.search(r"^## Concurrent agents\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", t, re.S | re.M)
assert m, "no section Concurrent agents"
s = m.group(1)
for w in ("sequential baseline", "dedup", "cache", "Haiku", "pack budget", "reading files"):
    assert w in s, w
assert s.count("reports/benchmarks.md") >= 3, "the conclusions cite no report section"

clauses.clause: kb/_self/token-efficiency.md gains a section Concurrent agents stating the conclusions the multi rows support on concurrency against the sequential baseline, coord dedup, prompt-cache reuse, Haiku against Sonnet and Opus per role, the pack budget and kb tools against reading files
each conclusion cites the section of the benchmarks report it rests on

notes: Conclusions only from the recorded rows; a knob the operator's answer left out is named as not measured.
